\code{FunctionField/KornblumSeries.lean} & Two lemmas on complex sequences and formal power series: bounded partial sums from a linear recurrence with non-vanishing symbol; positivity of coefficients from a non-negative logarithmic derivative & 279 \\
\code{FunctionField/KornblumVonMangoldt.lean} & The von Mangoldt identity over $\mathbb{F}_p[t]$: $n A_n(\varphi)=\sum_k \Psi_k(\varphi)A_{n-k}(\varphi)$ for a multiplicative $\varphi$, without Euler products & 307 \\
\code{FunctionField/KornblumCharacter.lean} & Characters of $\mathbb{F}_p[t]/Q$: exact cancellation of $A_n(\chi)$ for $n\ge\deg Q$, orthogonality, and $L(1/p,\chi)\ne 0$ for $\chi\ne 1$ (\code{lPoly\_eval\_ne\_zero}) & 455 \\
\code{FunctionField/Kornblum.lean} & \textbf{Kornblum's theorem}: \code{ffDirichletDensity} proves \code{FFDirichletDensity}; hence the almost-all theorem over $\mathbb{F}_p[t]$ is unconditional (\code{ff\_almost\_all\_genmixed\_density\_unconditional}) & 453 \\
\code{FunctionField/LinearSeeds.lean} & $\FF_5$: every linear seed $t+a$ is a perpetual tower (period is invariant under subtracting a constant) & 121 \\
\midrule
\multicolumn{3}{l}{\emph{Min--max dichotomy and obstruction calculus (new)}} \\
\code{Population/ClassInfinitude.lean} & Frozen residues $E_n\equiv 7\pmod{12}$; every Euclid number has a prime factor $\equiv3\pmod4$; $\mathrm{CI}(2\bmod 3)\Rightarrow(\mathrm{C}\infty)$, $\neg\mathrm{CI}(3\bmod4)\Rightarrow(\mathrm{C}\infty)$; after a prime Euclid number all prime factors of the next are $\equiv1\pmod3$ & 239 \\
\code{Population/HeadDynamics.lean} & The head (least missing prime): MC $\Leftrightarrow$ head $\to\infty$ $\Leftrightarrow$ $\lpf(E_n)=$ head i.o.\ $\Leftrightarrow$ $\lpf(E_n)\le f(\text{head})$; NotConfined $\Rightarrow(\mathrm{C}\infty)$; consecutive Euclid numbers coprime; hits after a hit are returns of the multiplier product to $1$ & 545 \\
\midrule
\multicolumn{3}{l}{\emph{Euclid systems theory (new)}} \\
\code{Population/GreedyRigidity.lean} & Rigidity of the greedy step (the equivariance scoping pass): \code{affine\_commute\_eq\_id}, the only affine map $m\mapsto am+b$ commuting with $T$ on seeds is the identity; \code{eq\_of\_itinerary\_eq}, two seeds with the same multiplier sequence are equal, so the branch determines its seed and a symmetry preserving the itinerary is trivial (\code{eq\_id\_of\_preserves\_itinerary}); \code{genProd\_comm\_of\_step\_comm}: a map commuting with $T$ maps forward orbits to forward orbits; \code{step\_two\_eq\_step\_three}: $T$ is not injective & 180 \\
\code{Population/EuclidClosed.lean} & Euclid's step with a freely chosen sub-product generates every prime (\code{IsEuclidClosed.mem\_of\_prime}, \code{generated\_iff\_prime}); Booker's theorem, the weakening of \code{MixedMC} that drops the whole-product constraint & 267 \\
\code{Population/SquareTree.lean} & The Euclid tree with exponents $1$ or $2$ reaches every prime, from any finite set of primes (\code{exists\_reach\_mem}, \code{exists\_reach\_superset}); the weakening of \code{MixedMC} that allows squares; algebraic core \code{no\_affine\_stable} & 305 \\
\code{Population/SquareBudget.lean} & The Euclid tree with at most $m$ squared primes per step (\code{ReachB}) reaches the prime $q$ as soon as $m \ge q-2$ (\code{exists\_reachB\_mem}); short sub-products mod $q$ (\code{exists\_small\_subset}); $m = 0$ is \code{MixedMC}, $m = 1$ is open and out of reach of residue arguments & 300 \\
\code{Population/FeedbackSelection.lean} & Feedback selection: every Euclid rule is the Sylvester map divided by its cofactor, $P_{n+1}c_n=P_n^2+P_n$ (\code{walkZ\_succ\_mul\_cofactor}); \code{sel\_cast\_eq\_of\_autonomous}, a rule whose multiplier mod $q$ is a function of the state mod $q$ is take-all mod $q$ (Dirichlet); \code{greedy\_not\_autonomous}; \code{deviates\_of\_dvd\_two\_mod\_three}, a capture of $q\equiv 2\ (3)$ is immediately preceded by a cofactor $\not\equiv 1\ (q)$; \code{frozen\_of\_autonomous\_tail}; \code{capture\_iff\_of\_autonomous\_tail}, capture on a residue-autonomous tail is decided in $<q$ steps; \code{autonomous\_rung}, MC $\Rightarrow$ NoFrozen $\Rightarrow$ NoAutonomousTail $\Rightarrow(\mathrm{C}\infty)$; \code{level\_prime\_of\_capture\_after\_run}, a prime captured after $k$ residue-autonomous stages is a level-$k$ prime of the Sylvester tree (the $\mathbb{Z}$-twin of the $\FF_2$ threshold; density of level-$k$ primes $\to 0$ by Odoni--Jones, cited); \code{stageAutonomous\_iff\_dvd\_cofactor\_sub\_one}, autonomy at stage $n$ is $q \mid c_n-1$. & 440 \\
\end{longtable}
